verdict.rationale: Forter documents an official MCP server that lets an AI system take real actions such as reviewing decisions and updating policies through natural language, and it can connect to Claude Desktop. That covers the core idea of an agent reading and changing fraud posture. However, nothing in the evidence shows rule or list management at the granularity the story asks for, or any approval workflow. Missing for 10: explicit velocity-rule creation, blocklist/allowlist read and update, documented human approval gates before changes apply, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read my fraud posture and manage rules and lists programmatically — propose a velocity rule, update a blocklist — with human approval gates

citations.quote: It enables an AI system to perform real actions—such as reviewing decisions, managing disputes, or updating policies through natural language commands.
Connect Forter MCP to Claude Desktop app for conversational AI workflows.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.forter.com/mcp
